utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the repair drive is moving along. I can swing by and spread the word if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That would help. I’ll keep it simple and stick to the plan.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Good. I’ll keep nudging folks gently so the plan stays easy to follow.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: What’s the quickest way I can help with the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Point me to the biggest gap, and I’ll take that first.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, Pia, this is the repair drive for the neighborhood project, right?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, that’s right — it’s for the neighborhood repair drive. I just want to make sure the supplies and timing are all sorted.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, and the supplies and timing are both confirmed?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the repair drive. I might’ve misplaced the details, but I’m here to help however I can.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: No worries. If you find the repair list, bring it by and I’ll check what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Will do, Cleo. If I come across the repair list, I’ll bring it right over.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Can you tell me what needs repairing and when you want it done?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I think it’s mostly the kitchen sink and maybe the hallway light? I’d like it done sometime this week, if that works.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you confirm which repairs are highest priority, and should I aim for earlier in the week or just anytime this week?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late — what still needs doing on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Mostly the heavy lifting’s set up, but we still need hands on sorting materials and patching the fence line. I can point you to the spot that needs the most help.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m here now — point me to the fence line and I’ll get on the sorting too.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Gus. I’m happy to help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Glad to hear it. I can bring over my tool kit and we can knock out whatever needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Perfect, Gus. With your kit and my hands, we should be able to get a lot done.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can check the repair drive location, if you want.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, please check it if you can.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ll check and let you know where it is.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I heard they’re still looking for a few more volunteers this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I can swing by after lunch if they still need hands.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great, that’d help a lot. I’ll tell them you’re coming by after lunch.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Rey, what do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Just let me know what parts you still need, and I can help fill the gaps.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I still need the list of parts you’re missing, and I’ll see what I can cover.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll keep pushing the repair drive along and let Nell know what’s next.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it, just let me know what changes next.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll keep you posted on what changes next.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Of course, Uli. I’ll keep the repair drive organized and let you know what still needs attention.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa. I appreciate you keeping track of it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: You’re welcome, Uli. I’ll keep you posted as I sort out the remaining repairs.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, you heard about that too? I can tell you it’s been the talk of the block all morning.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I did, and I’m keeping to the facts until I know what’s actually being fixed. If there’s a schedule, I’d like it straight.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I heard the schedule’s supposed to go up by noon, and I’m told they’re starting with the east side first.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I'm late, Vik. What still needs doing on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Not much left, just the shelf fix and the loose hinge, then we can call it done.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great, I can help with the hinge if you take the shelf fix.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with the repair drive, if you want to tell me what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Just the wiring and one bracket left. I can show you what’s still open.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Show me the wiring first, then we can check the bracket.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I can help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I need you to check the east storage shed first, then bring the 10mm wrench and the spare hose back to me.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it, I’ll grab the 10mm wrench and the spare hose from the east storage shed and bring them over.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help spread the word and line up a few hands if you need.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That would help a lot, thanks. I’ll check what still needs doing and then I’ll let you know what to bring.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, just let me know what you need and I’ll keep helping line up people and supplies.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, the repair drive. I think I missed the latest update, but I can help if you tell me what changed.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’ll fill you in, but first I need to check what changed so I don’t hand you the wrong update.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Okay, tell me what changed and I’ll keep track this time.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard there’s a repair drive going on. Need a hand with anything?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, I can bring my drill and wrench set by later.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, I’ll bring by some extra extension cords too.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, I can help with the repair drive. What needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Just the repair drive itself. I need help replacing a busted connector.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Got it, I can help with that. Show me the busted connector and I’ll take a look.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, but I need the schedule and who’s covering transport before I can commit.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What times are you free, and who’s taking the van?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m free after 3, but I still need to know who’s got the van before I can say yes.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I heard the repair drive is getting started soon, so I’m passing the word now. You should come by if you can help or need anything fixed.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can come by and bring a couple of things if you need them. Just tell me what’s short.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, swing by and bring whatever you can spare. I’ll let everyone know what we’re short on.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help if you need me to coordinate around the school run.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Faye. I might need a bit of a hand, so I’ll let you know what needs lining up.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Of course. Send me the details when you have them, and I’ll see what I can line up around the school run.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’ve got the repair drive list ready, Nell. Tell me what you can take on, and I’ll match you with a task that fits.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I can take on something simple if that helps. What needs doing most right now?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: The easiest thing is probably sorting and bagging the small repair supplies. I can put you on that if you’d like.
